fee_schedule.note: Public perpetual fee tiers. Research does not know operator account tier without private data; default scenario uses Tier 1, with a documented taker-fee range across tiers.

notes: Maker is not modeled as zero-fee taker.

Adverse selection uses post-fill signed mid when available.
